title: Yonge and Rosehill Development Site Goes High-End With Expanded Team
summary: Plans for are being revised for a residential tower at the northeast corner of Yonge Street and Rosehill Avenue in Toronto's Deer Park area. Proposed to the City of Toronto for a site just two blocks just south of Yonge and St Clair, plans for a 52-storey condo tower have gone from it being a shoebox-sized investor unit building to a high-end luxury residence with far fewer but larger suites, reflecting current conditions of the Toronto real estate market.
